`final class ContractDraw`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.test.contract` · **Module:** `tool-testkit` · **Source:** [ContractDraw.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/tool/testkit/src/main/java/dev/joid/test/contract/ContractDraw.java)

The helpers of the contract suites, for contract tests of your own: a frame around a drawing, quads and vertices, a shader from a fragment stage, a pixel assertion.

## Learn more

- [The suites](/build/testing-a-backend/#the-suites)

## Method details

<a id="ContractDraw-method-frame"></a>

### frame

`SnapshotImage frame(ISnapshotBackend backend, int width, int height, Consumer<IRenderBridge> draw)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Begins a frame, clears it to opaque black, runs the drawing, ends the frame, then returns the capture of that size and presents.

<a id="ContractDraw-method-reset"></a>

### reset

`void reset(int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Resets the modelview, an orthographic projection of that size from the top-left corner, and a render state with that viewport, normal blending and no depth writes.

<a id="ContractDraw-method-shader"></a>

### shader

`IShader shader(String fragment)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns a shader of that fragment stage, with a vertex stage that applies the projection and the modelview.

<a id="ContractDraw-method-assertPixel"></a>

### assertPixel

`void assertPixel(SnapshotImage image, int x, int y, int expected)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Fails with both colors in hexadecimal when the pixel at that position is not that ARGB color.

<a id="ContractDraw-method-quad"></a>

### quad

`VertexBuffer quad(float x, float y, float width, float height, float z, boolean texture, int color, boolean normal, float start, float end)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns two triangles of that rectangle at that depth, with texture coordinates from `start` to `end`, and an ARGB vertex color when it is not `0`.

<a id="ContractDraw-method-vertices"></a>

### vertices

`VertexBuffer vertices(float[][] points, float z, boolean texture, int color, boolean normal)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Returns a vertex buffer of those points, each `{x, y, u, v}`, at that depth, with the texture coordinates, the color and the normal flags of the buffer.
